title: Raccoon wearing sunglasses
svg:

  <path d='M44 70 Q50 75 56 70' stroke='#9aa0aa' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='8' ry='3' fill='#f4f5f8'/>
</svg>
